_doc: AI sprite list. size = [w, h] in pixels at 32 px per tile. texture = fill the whole tile (walls, floors). neg = extra negative prompt.
style: pixel art game sprite, single object, centered, simple readable shapes, thick dark outline, flat colors, post-apocalyptic, plain white background

survivor.prompt: chibi proportions, big head, short body, survivor with patched jacket, scarf and backpack, full body standing, front view

raider.prompt: chibi proportions, big head, short body, wasteland raider in studded leather vest, red bandana, goggles, metal shoulder pad, cargo pants, full body standing, front view
raider.neg: realistic proportions, tall, thin, shirtless, bare chest

rad_rat.prompt: mutant radioactive rat with glowing green spots, side view

glowcorn_plant.prompt: mutant corn plant with glowing green cobs, side view

car_wreck.prompt: rusted wrecked car, three quarter top-down view

canned_food.prompt: game item icon, tin can of food with a paper label printed with beans, slightly dented, front view

scrap_bed.prompt: double bed seen from directly above, top-down view, rusty metal frame, worn mattress, two pillows at the top, patched blanket

scrap_bench.prompt: rusty scrap metal workbench with tools, three quarter top-down view

scrap_generator.prompt: small diesel generator made of scrap with exhaust pipe, three quarter top-down view

scrap_wall.prompt: seamless square texture tile, wall of rusty corrugated metal sheets with rivets and patches, flat front view, fills the whole square edge to edge
